name: Riad Marwa Marrakech
description: Riad Marwa is located in the Bab Doukala district of the medina, a 20-minute walk from the Majorelle Garden and Jamaâ El Fna Square. Each room includes free Wi-Fi, a safe, and a private bathroom. All rooms are air-conditioned. Enjoy mint tea on the patio and terrace, as well as traditional Moroccan meals. A continental breakfast is served each morning. Other meals featuring traditional Moroccan specialties can be enjoyed by the fountain in the courtyard or on the terrace. Airport transfers and excursions can also be arranged by the property.
